items.title: Accept or decline the offered daycare (Krippen) place
items.quote: Bitte sagen Sie uns binnen 12 Arbeitstagen ab dem Datum dieses Briefes zu oder ab.
items.computation: Private sender (gGmbH), so no statutory Bekanntgabefiktion applies; the letter itself fixes the start as its own date, 19.11.2026 (Thursday). Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the triggering event is not counted, so counting starts 20.11.2026 (Friday). The letter defines 'Arbeitstage' explicitly as Monday-Friday with public holidays excluded, which matches the general rule. Counting only Mon-Fri from 20.11.2026, skipping weekends (no public holiday falls in this window in NRW, the recipient's Land): day1=Fri 20.11, day2=Mon 23.11, day3=Tue 24.11, day4=Wed 25.11, day5=Thu 26.11, day6=Fri 27.11, day7=Mon 30.11, day8=Tue 01.12, day9=Wed 02.12, day10=Thu 03.12, day11=Fri 04.12, day12=Mon 07.12.2026. The 12th working day is Monday 07.12.2026, already a working day, so no further weekend/holiday shift (§193 BGB) is needed. If no reply is given, the place is given to the next family on the waiting list.
